dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderately concave spline fitting the posterior boundary from the dorsal insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape with a very low pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep angular ascent, approximately 60 degrees relative to the longitudinal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: High vertical-to-horizontal ratio where maximum pixel height exceeds base width.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Defined circular arc representing the structural convexity of the forehead.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick protrusion with a high thickness-to-length ratio extending from the cranial inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Clear obtuse transition angle between the melon descent and the start of the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity cyan and white luminescence patterns across the lateral and dorsal surfaces, characteristic of a digital rendering rather than biological pigmentation.
